integrity: Exact tables computed from all 4096 codewords, checked through an independent polynomial-division and direct-window implementation. No extrapolation from samples. Independent audit not performed.
limitations: Fixed standard cyclic coordinate order for the binary [23,12,7] Golay code, not arbitrary permutations or the extended [24,12,8] code.
Exact exhaustive finite code census; no result for other code lengths or unrelated codes.
The pair-distance lower bound 11 follows from prior general theory and is not asserted to be a new lower bound.
Unindexed historical tables are possible; historical priority has not been independently certified.
The complete minimum b-read distance hierarchy through width 11 was explicitly published by Guan et al. in 2025 and is not part of this novelty claim.
General stabilization of b-symbol weight enumerators for b at least code dimension was published by Shi–Özbudak–Solé in 2021.
The elementary cyclic zero-run-to-window identity was already used in related published work and is not claimed novel.
title: Complete cyclic \(b\)-symbol spectra of the binary Golay \([23,12,7]\) code
